quote: I attended a session with Martin for 3+ hours yet the time passed by very quickly because of the high level of engagement during the day. There was a very good mix of practice and conversation/theory so it was easy to absorb key information and reflect on the learning as we progressed. The group activities allowed me to share my opinion whilst also actively listen to that of others, creating a safe space to discuss bad as well as good habits. As a visually impaired person, I found Martin's response to my concerns very very positive. He was not only kind enough to accommodate my requests on the day, but he also followed-up on this and asked me for feedback on how to improve this session going forward from an accessibility perspective. I look forward to attending another session with Martin.
author: Giulia Peluso
subject: Soft Skills Training
